title: FINALE
subtitle: The Fractured Core
rewardRelicDesc: The mark of the Worldmender. Your base gains +30 max HP, all units gain +6 ATK and +8 max HP, and your maximum mana is increased by 2.

intro.title: THE FRACTURED CORE
intro.text:
You have crossed thirteen shards, faced their champions, and collected their secrets. The path has always led here — to the wound at the world's heart.

The Fracture Event tore reality apart and scattered the Dominion into pieces. Something caused it. Something remains at the centre.

intro.title: THE FORCE WITHIN
intro.text:
The Fractured Core does not feel like a place. It feels like the absence of one — a scar where the world used to be whole.

The entity within has no name. No origin. It simply is the fracture, given will and hunger.

intro.title: THE END OF THE ROAD
intro.text:
There is no one left to send. No other path to walk. You are Jarv, wandering tactician, and this is the last battlefield.

If the Core falls, the world begins to heal. If you fall, there is no one else.

outro.title: THE FRACTURE CLOSES
outro.text:
The entity shudders. Writhes. And then — for the first time since the cataclysm — something at the heart of the world goes quiet.

The wound begins to close.

outro.title: HEALING
outro.text:
Across the shards, the tremors stop. The Verdant Shard's roots spread back into cracked stone. The Iron Citadel's fires die down. The Ashen Wastes, slowly, begin to grey.

It will take generations. But it has begun.

outro.title: WORLDMENDER
outro.text:
You stand at the heart of what was broken and watch the pieces, impossibly, start to drift back together.

You did this. You, and every unit you sent forward, every choice you made, every shard you crossed.

Worldmender.

last-bridge.label: The Last Bridge
last-bridge.description: Fractured reality has given form to its first defenders.

shattered-halls.label: Shattered Halls
shattered-halls.description: The corridors of the Core are alive with hostile energy.

echo-of-the-core.label: Echo of the Core
echo-of-the-core.description: Reality splinters here. The Fracture sees you.

fractures-herald.label: The Fracture's Herald
fractures-herald.description: A projection of the Fracture itself — testing your limits before the end.

the-fracture-node.label: The Fracture
the-fracture-node.description: The source of the cataclysm. The end of the world — or yours.
bossDialogue: YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE COME HERE.
THE FRACTURE IS ETERNAL. YOU ARE NOT.
